**Verdict: Not built by this review — needs a maintainer look.** The code reads correct. This review did not compile or run it.

## What looks good

- The fix is minimal and correct. `assets/posts/heidenhain.cps:737` writes `qword(208, RETRACT_FEED_MAX)`. Q208 appears only in the G205 branch, so no other cycle writes it. `qword` (`assets/posts/heidenhain.cps:633`) formats `99999.999` as `+99999.999`, which matches the golden.
- The value choice is well sourced. The decision record cites the documented range (0 to 99999.999) and the manual's own example (`Q208=99999`). It also names what was considered and dropped, including why `Q208=0` was refused. This fits the Clean-Room Protocol: public manuals, behaviour only.
- The test hardening is good work. `crates/post/tests/heidenhain_cycles.rs:158` now fails on any Q value that is not a signed number. That covers every cycle the file tests (G200, G205, G206, G207), not only Q208. I confirmed every Q word in the post script goes through `qword`, so the new assert cannot fire on legitimate output.
- Independent station proof exists: qsmits read the new `drill_peck.nc` back clean on the iTNC 530 (606425 004 SP20), and the old FMAX file still errored, in the same session (#3102 comment, 2026-11-21T09:26Z).
- Process checks pass: conventional subject, `Fixes #3102`, `Changelog:` line, no `CHANGELOG.md` edit, no process files touched, no new crate dependencies, golden change intended and explained, no snapshot PNGs touched.

## Results

- **Not built here.** The self-hosted `pr-test.yml` runner accepts a collaborator's PR only; this PR's author is not a collaborator. No local build slot was open during this review, so the touched suites and clippy were not run here.
- **Merge check (git only):** the head merges clean with current `origin/main` (6b63e442b) — `git merge-tree` gives no conflicts; GitHub reports MERGEABLE / CLEAN.
- Author-reported gates (not verified by this review): quick 674/675 steps ok, the one red step (`ai_guide_calls_match_live_tools_list` on a CRLF checkout) is unrelated and filed as #3119; heavy `app heavy` 198 steps ok, 0 failed, run on this exact head 2c9d79af.

## Heavy lanes

- The diff reaches `app heavy` (it changes `crates/post` and an app golden). The PR body names a green author run of that lane on head 2c9d79af0. This review did not re-run it; a maintainer run on the merge candidate closes the gap.

## Requested before merge

- None in the code.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- The physical Fehlmann check (NC software 340490-03) is still open. The decision record names it and the fallback (refuse G205 there if it also refuses the number). Worth one line on #3102 when the machine test runs.
- `crates/post/tests/heidenhain_cycles.rs:213`: the assert message says "no Q word is FMAX" but checks the whole program, not only Q words. The stricter check is fine; the wording could match the check.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
